verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents a public API reference with JSON responses, a Postman collection, sandbox test keys, and API-driven operations across charges, transfers, subscriptions, virtual accounts, and FX. Probes confirm agent-readable llms.txt and docs.md are live. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
